s191_report.outcome: STOP: kill rule fired (class_sum_vs_body_pct); the class table is not reported
s191_report.rule: measurement: per rank, per phase, per class: ms/half, us per GDN and QSA layer, excess over the 537 GB/s copy floor (packet72/77 byte formulas) and over packet110 (roofline.json @128); lever-eligible by excess iff excess over the floor >= 15.1 us per GDN layer on BOTH ranks (3.8 us screen) with the DO-NOT-REPEAT closures named; kill rules: exact/proposals, off drift > 0.5 %, on/off < 0.93 (table withheld, never ratio-corrected), class sums vs body > 10 %

kill_rules.overhead_rule: packet128: "A failed overhead gate withholds rankings. Do not correct event times by a throughput ratio." (packet128b measured 0.728 and withheld; packet191 samples 24 of 127 fixtures)
